name: Billerbeck (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Billerbeck (two blue wavy bends on white).
history: By deed of the Bezirksregierung Münster of 11 November 1970 the city was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a banner; the hoisted flag is blue-white-blue 1:3:1 striped with the arms.

features.role: Billerbeck arms — blue wavy bends on white
